summary: * Core: Add max-file-group-input-files to valid rewrite options (#17544) * Data, Spark: Support byte[] binary values in InternalRowConverter (#17482) * API: Define RepairManifests action interface (#17399) - Implementation PR (#17622) is in review. The files can be replaced by Cargo-generated data and CI policies, and the change aims to reduce maintainer burden while addressing attribution needs for Python bindings. Polaris fails such requests with HTTP 400 and a message naming the reason, because in these cases the inability is a static property of the catalog and a 200 without credentials would only move the failure to the first data access. Dan, I think the catalog-controlled direction and Alex's wording are compatible, and it may help to separate the two roles the header plays today: This milestone tracks going proposals for the fourth version of the Table Spec
